initialFailures.description: New default policy assertions reproduce the missing implementation.
Existing no-delay lifecycle fixtures did not advance restored timers; corrected to explicitly exercise workspace mode. Hung runtime fixture worker was stopped, not counted as a completed passing run.
Before final rerun strict checking rejected optional delay at normalization. Numeric normalization now follows runtime numeric validation; final log contains the passing rerun.

Chromium same-file replacement did not fire change when published policy retained input value, leaving the original job active. Test now clears selection then chooses the same file; production input retention is preserved.

limitations: Windows WebKit native HTTP loads but Blob returns media error 4; annotated checks are capability controls, not extraction passes or Safari evidence.
Historical defect-control passes do not imply historical cleanup correctness.
No complete original npm 3.5.31 archive or historical declaration recovered.
PKG-TOOL-THUMB-05/06 integration and packaging disposition remain separate gates.
No physical device, remote CI, publication or formal review completed by this change.
